findings.title: New comment's justification ("traits never go back to hidden") doesn't cover a hidden trait added later
findings.detail: The comment says an unwrapped leftover stays harmless because traits never return to hidden. A single trait can't (discovered is only set true, TitanTrait.cs:39), but TitanUtility.AddTrait defaults to discovered=false (Hediff_Titan.cs:127), and a pawn that becomes a titan after an earlier cast had GetTitan return null at that cast. Either way an unwrapped leftover can exist while something is now hidden. Behaviour is still correct: this call's fresh entries are wrapped, share the same ticksAwayFromCast, and vanilla fires every entry whose threshold has been reached in the same loop (Ability.cs:941-946), so the reveal happens that tick anyway. Suggest the comment state that reason instead.
